purchasePathNote: Phoenix was never sold. Sanctuary offered its robots as 'labor as a service' in pilots, and its current website sells physical AI software and robotic hands for other robots, with no Phoenix offer.

sellers.name: Sanctuary AI (official)
sellers.offers: No Phoenix offer or price; 'Commercial Inquiry' form for its physical AI software and hydraulic hands.

faq.q: Can you buy Sanctuary AI Phoenix?
faq.a: No. Sanctuary has never sold Phoenix, and its website no longer lists it as a product.
Sanctuary never published a price. In 2023 its CMO said the model was 'labor as a service', with hourly pricing that varies by business and task.

faq.q: Can you lease Phoenix as a service?
faq.a: Sanctuary described a labor-as-a-service model when it launched Phoenix in 2023, but its current site offers software and hands, not Phoenix robots.

notes: Hourly figures (for example CAD 20-30 per hour) and $150,000-$300,000 unit prices on third-party sites have no primary source and are not included. Sanctuary's site now presents hardware-agnostic physical AI for existing industrial robots.
